@LemSix213NoQ.replay : ∀ {τ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype τ] {δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ δ →
    δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ {r : Option τ → ℕ},
        3 ≤ ↑(r none) →
          (∀ (j : τ), ↑(r none) ≤ δ * ↑(r (some j))) →
            ∀ {r₁ : ℕ},
              (∀ (j : Option τ), r j ≤ r₁) →
                ∀ {q : Option τ → ℕ} {B : ℝ} {R : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ},
                  R ∈ LemSix213NoQ.RSet B r →
                    ∀ {h : Option τ → ℤ},
                      (∀ (j : Option τ), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
                        ∃ l,
                          1 ≤ l ∧
                            l ≤ r none + 1 ∧
                              Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤
                                2 *
                                  (LemSix213NoQ.lem6Φ q r (LemSix213NoQ.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l +
                                      √(LemSix213NoQ.lem6Φ q r (LemSix213NoQ.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l) +
                                    √δ)
